label: Argo Workflows: render and check Helm chart (explicit)
command: mkdir -p "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.argo-ls" && output=$(mktemp -d "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.argo-ls/render-XXXXXX") && /absolute/path/to/bundle/native/server.bin render-check --root "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" --helm-binary /absolute/path/to/helm3 --chart "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/chart" --values "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/values.yaml" --target-version 3.6.0 --output "$output"; result=$?; printf '\nRender evidence: %s\n' "$output"; exit "$result"
